name: lnx
description: Build a link-in-bio page right from your chat: one short lnx.net/yourname link for all your links, socials and bio.

interface.shortDescription: One link for everything you do
interface.longDescription:
One link for everything you do.

Tell ChatGPT who you are and what you'd like to share (your shop, booking page, latest video, socials) and LNX builds a polished link-in-bio page for you. Put lnx.net/yourname in your Instagram, TikTok or YouTube bio, your email signature or on your business card, and everyone finds everything in one place.

• Up to 20 links and 10 social profiles, plus a tagline and a short bio
• Three themes to match your style
• Checks that lnx.net/yourname is still available and suggests alternatives if it isn't
• Open the link to see your finished page, add a photo and fine-tune anything, then publish when you're happy

Nothing goes live until you say so. Pages come with click analytics and a QR code. Made for creators, freelancers, artists and small businesses.
defaultPrompt: Make me a link-in-bio page for my Instagram bio
Build a page for my small business with our menu, phone and socials

positive.description: Create a page for a creator from details in the conversation
positive.prompt: Make me a link-in-bio page. I'm Maya Ferreira, a ceramic artist in Lisbon. Shop: mayaceramics.example.com/shop, Instagram @mayaceramics.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_page with name Maya Ferreira, a tagline about ceramics in Lisbon, a shop link and an instagram social, and gives the user the returned claim_url. Opening it shows the finished page in the LNX editor without an account.
Calls check_username and says lnx.net/mayaceramics is available.

positive.description: Small business page with phone and email
positive.prompt: Create a page for my bakery Brotzeit: menu at brotzeit.example/menu, phone +43 1 234 5678, email hello@brotzeit.example.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_page with a menu link, a tel: link for the phone number and an email social profile, and returns the claim_url.

positive.prompt: Make my page at lnx.net/tobias. I'm Tobias, a photographer; portfolio at tobiasphoto.example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: The tool reports that tobias is taken and suggests alternatives such as tobias_me. ChatGPT asks the user which name to use instead of choosing silently; after the user picks one it calls create_page again and returns the claim_url.

positive.description: Podcast page with several platforms and a theme
positive.prompt: Make a page for my podcast Night Shift with Spotify open.spotify.com/show/example, YouTube youtube.com/@nightshiftpod and Apple Podcasts podcasts.apple.com/podcast/id123, boxy theme.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_page with spotify and youtube social profiles, Apple Podcasts as a link, and theme boxy; returns the claim_url.

negative.description: Unrelated request: no LNX tool should run
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Vienna tomorrow?

negative.description: Analytics of an existing page are not available through the plugin; it must not create a page or invent numbers
negative.prompt: Show me the click analytics for lnx.net/tobias.

negative.description: The plugin cannot publish or edit an existing page; it must not claim a page is live
negative.prompt: Delete my lnx.net page and publish a new one right now without me opening anything.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments.
